notes.title: Flight 737 - MAXIMUM 1.1 UPDATE
notes.notes:
List of Updates
* All Menu visuals have been redesigned and made more useful
* Many graphical textures have been made more detailed
* New Reflection, Shading and Light features have been added
* It has become easier to use your own or externally found aircraft textures
* Weather events such as Snow and Rain have been made more detailed and realistic
* New lighting features have been added to the cockpit
* Cockpit Texture and Detailing have been corrected to be more realistic
* New functional button elements have been added to the cockpit
* Graphical parts such as FMC and Flight Plan have been renewed and made more realistic
* Shortcuts have been added to the Keyboard controls in the game
* Game controls now support a wide variety of control devices such as Gamepad, Joystick
* JetFighter and Forklift have been graphically renewed and gamepad support has been given
* Helicopter mode has been added to the game
* Many bugs have been fixed
* More understandable options have been added instead of complex settings
* Video lessons have been redone
